newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Coffee due flat, may attack resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Coffee due flat, may attack resistance.

text.p: MAY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Traders expected coffee to open unchanged, but analysts saw an assault on resistance as possible.
"It's more likely to have a punch at resistance than worry about support," independent analyst Elli Gifford said.
Resistance stood at $1,650 a tonne, but the March 26 high of $1,675 was more important, she said.
"Support looks reasonable below $1,600," she added, putting lower support levels down to $1,570.
"Robusta coffee is being amply satisfied from the Indonesian main harvest, so London should continue to underperform," brokers GNI said.
New York coffee futures ended higher again Thursday on moderate volume, but the two nearby contracts traded inside Wednesday's range.
Sentiment is likely to go on being bolstered by a strike by stevedores in Brazil.
But a threatened Colombian truck drivers' strike set for April 20 may be declared illegal by the government, the Colombian Transport Minister said on Thursday.
